title: Evaluate conditional Umegaki channel comparison by exact covariance and three small LMIs
status_authority: Actual version-bound scoped internal review governs acceptance. Source reports, mathematical verification and physical acquisition remain separate.
reported_status: accepted_internally_verified at the specified mathematical, computational or descriptive scope of the completed substantive internal reviews. No physical advantage or historical priority established; mission NOT_ACHIEVED.
scientific_scope_status: For strictly positive rational column-stochastic 3x3 classical channels K,L, with L injective on zero-sum inputs, the all-finite-quantum-reference conditional-Umegaki coefficient has an exact three-LMI global certificate. K may be singular. A denominator-only operator covariance removes inverse K. Above one, scalar vertex certificates suffice; below one, a common rational center gives an exactly checkable upper bound and real active dimension at most two suffices in closure. The Umegaki active/vacuum lift needs one additional reference dimension. The selected portable evaluator returns exact rational upper certificates and lower witnesses; both reviewed implementations passed ten frozen asymmetric cases and three controls.
